    cls.hpx_shortcuts = cls.fc.fd[FLOW_NAMES.HPX_SHORTCUTS]

def test_01_verify_the_screen_when_user_clicks_on_the_create_your_own_shortcut_arrow_button_in_add_new_shortcuts_screen_C46(self):
        """
        Verify the screen.
        TestRails -> https://hp-testrail.external.hp.com/index.php?/cases/view/46
        """
        self.fc.reset_app()
        self.fc.flow_load_home_screen(skip_value_prop=False)

        self.hpx_printer_details.click_shortcuts_tile(raise_e=False)
        assert self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_shortcuts_screen_title()
        self.hpx_shortcuts.click_add_new_shortcut_btn()
        assert self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_add_new_shortcut_screen_title()

automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All test scenarios requiring sequential execution

automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All automation method implementations

automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All UI automation scripts
rule_definition: WHEN: Creating automation for UI interactions
THEN: Implement Page Object Model pattern with separate page classes containing locators and methods

automation_scripts_rules.description: Error Handling and Wait Condition Rule
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All element interactions and state changes
rule_definition: WHEN: Performing any UI interaction or waiting for state changes
THEN: Implement explicit waits with configurable timeouts and comprehensive error handling

IMPLEMENTATION: Use WebDriverWait with expected_conditions, implement try-catch blocks with context capture, log failures with screenshots and state information, and provide actionable error messages for debugging.

automation_scripts_rules.description: Test Data and Configuration Management Rule
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All automation scripts using test data or environment-specific settings
rule_definition: WHEN: Automation requires test data, credentials, URLs, or environment-specific configuration
THEN: Externalize all data and configuration in separate files with environment-based loading

IMPLEMENTATION: Store test data in JSON/YAML files, use configuration files per environment, load data at test initialization, never hard-code values in methods, and support configuration override via environment variables.

        """
        Verify the behavior when user enables the print destination toggle bar.
        TestRails -> https://hp-testrail.external.hp.com/index.php?/cases/view/51

        self.fc.reset_app()
        self.fc.flow_load_home_screen(skip_value_prop=False)
        self.hpx_printer_details.click_add_device_btn()
        self.printers.search_printer_by_ip(self.p.ipAddress)
        self.hpx_printer_details.click_printer_device_card()
        self.hpx_printer_details.click_shortcuts_tile(raise_e=False)
        assert self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_shortcuts_screen_title()
        self.hpx_shortcuts.click_add_new_shortcut_btn()
        assert self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_add_new_shortcut_screen_title()
        self.hpx_shortcuts.click_create_your_own_shortcut()
        self.hpx_shortcuts.click_edit_shortcut_print_toggle_btn()
        assert self.hpx_shortcuts.is_continue_btn_enabled(), "Continue button should be enabled after toggling print option"
